title: Ravin bar Kisi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 20b: “Ravina said: Ravin bar Kisi told me.” Hyman reports the Maharshal’s reading Rava; see the entry Ravya.[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Chullin 20b paragraph begins with Ravina saying that Ravin bar Kisi told him, preserving the nested direction. The Maharshal’s alternative Rava was not freshly collated and remains Hyman’s report. The supplied cross-reference רביא is retained as Ravya rather than silently harmonized to Rava. No identity or correction-history conclusion is admitted.
